question: Does Sentry for Startups need a dev-services record? The help article states USD 5,000 of credits (written $5,000 on the page) that expire 1 year after joining, for a company founded in the last 2 years that raised under USD 5M (written $5M) of venture capital.
why: The terms come from https://www.sentry.help/en/articles/13965055-do-you-offer-a-discount-to-startups. The offer is gated on a company, so its identity kind and the application form at sentry.io/for/startups/apply/ are not read yet. It lies outside the slice of the Sentry education plan.
